query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_images,
  SUM(CASE WHEN altText IS NOT NULL AND altText != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_alt_text,
  SUM(CASE WHEN altText IS NULL OR altText = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_alt_text
FROM projectImages;
